summary: Allarity Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing that its wholly-owned subsidiary, ALLR Sponsor LLC, will sponsor Allarity Acquisition Corp., a newly formed SPAC that publicly filed a Form S-1 for a proposed $100 million IPO, or $115 million with full over-allotment exercise. ALLR Sponsor LLC is expected to hold approximately 25.0% of the SPAC's issued and outstanding ordinary shares post-offering. Jesper Hoiland, an Allarity board member and former Novo Nordisk executive, will serve as SPAC chairman; units applied for Nasdaq listing under ALLNU. Watch the separation mechanics between ALLR and the SPAC, sponsor promote economics, and potential shareholder dilution or valuation overhang risk.
